crossRefs.note: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
the rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.

parallels.note: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

translations.web: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
translations.bsb: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
translations.asv: And thou shalt make the staves of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
